authoringSurface.decision: Both a composition field and a CLI flag, additive within composition-1 (no schema version change; old JSON keeps its meaning).
compositionFields: Top-level fontCoverage: "legacy" | "strict" (optional; default legacy). The document itself can require exact faces for any renderer.
Font asset fallbacks: 1–4 other pinned font asset ids (optional). It changes rendering, so it must live in the composition, not a flag.
authoringSurface.cliFlag: --font-coverage legacy|strict on comp validate, render and lint; also the fontCoverage option of readCompositionSource, renderComposition and lintCompositionFile. The effective profile is the stricter of composition and caller: a flag can raise but never lower.
authoringSurface.mechanismFormat: mechanism-narrated-cycle-1 omits fallbacks from its embedded font schema; its generated schema is byte-identical. Mechanism episodes keep their own strict font gate (mechanism/io.ts).

engineChanges: packages/renderer-core/src/composition/font-coverage.ts: pure inspectCompositionFonts / compositionFontFallbacks over the existing readFontIdentity, inspectFontText and collectFontTextRuns (no second cmap parser).

packages/renderer-core/src/composition/render/text-scenes.ts: Node-safe text-layer → typography-scene mapping moved out of render/text.ts so Node coverage and browser preparation read identical reachable copy.

packages/animation-engine/src/composition-font-coverage.ts + composition-source.ts: gate runs after asset checksums, before media/audio preparation and any browser work; strict errors throw PassageError, legacy findings join warnings; source.fontCoverage report.

packages/renderer-core/src/prepared-fonts.ts + render/text.ts: declared fallbacks register as extra FontFaces under a distinct family `StillShift-<sha>-fallback-<digest>` with unicode-range of exactly the resolved code points, at the primary's weight/style descriptors, including derived style/axis families. Only compositions declaring fallbacks take this path.
CLI help and option parsing; render result fontCoverage (conditional); scene-contract fields, comp-font-fallback code, generated schema and composition reference.

rules.unit: Unicode code point against the font's selected Unicode cmap (format 4 or 12).
rules.exemptControls: Tab, LF, CR, ZWSP U+200B, ZWNJ U+200C, ZWJ U+200D, LRM/RLM, BOM U+FEFF, bidi embeddings/isolates U+202A–202E and U+2066–2069, variation selectors.
rules.marksAndSpaces: Combining marks and every other space (U+0020, U+00A0, U+3000 …) must be in the font.
rules.fallbackResolution: Each missing code point goes to the first declared fallback that has it; not transitive; never a system face. A grapheme cluster drawn by more than one face is font-fallback-cluster.
rules.limits: Coverage is necessary evidence, not proof of shaping or mark placement. With fallbacks the browser still shapes; the face per glyph is declared (fallbackResolution: declared-unicode-range), not measured. The fallback face renders at the primary font's weight/style descriptors.
